prompt: Make a narrated product demo of the Swag Labs store. The accepted usernames and the password are listed on the login page — sign in as standard_user. Show three things, as separate scenes: (1) signing in and landing on the product list; (2) sorting the products by price low to high, then adding the backpack and the bike light to the cart; (3) opening the cart, going through checkout with a made-up name and postal code, and finishing on the order confirmation page. The cart must contain exactly those two items when it is shown. Narrate it like a friendly product walkthrough.
